notes.title: Early Access
notes.content: [p][b]Wasteland Warriors[/b] will be entering Early Access in the upcoming weeks, and [b]YOU[/b] have the power to help shape it! Your feedback is critical to the development of Wasteland Warriors. If something feels off, confusing, too easy, too hard, or just plain fun, we want to hear about it.[/p][p]While the core systems are in place and the game is in a playable state, we're still adding content, balancing, fixing bugs, and refining the overall experience. Some things might break. Some things might feel rough. But that’s part of the process and we want you along for the ride.[/p][p]Join the [url="https://discord.gg/G2cDWyyRY7"]Discord [/url]to chat with the devs (yes, it's just the two of us!), share your feedback, report bugs, request features, and help shape the future of the [b]Wasteland[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Josh[/p][p]2DPK Studios[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="nOmw_TOBHz0;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content: [p]Drones, Difficulty, and Devastation![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="a0KZVUdd7iw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In this update, we’re diving deep into the latest progress on Wasteland Warriors! From major gameplay changes to brand-new features, here’s what’s cooking:[/p][p][/p][p]🔹 New Game Options – Customize your experience with toggleable UI features, camera controls, shared scrap, and more. [/p][p]🔹 Difficulty System Overhaul – Choose your challenge! Our curve-based difficulty scales with days, waves, and player count for intense, dynamic gameplay. [/p][p]🔹 Quarantine Zone Combat – We’ve locked the battlefield to ramp up the pressure and deliver true bullet-hell chaos. [/p][p]🔹 Combat Drones Are Here! – Finally, firepower! Our prototype drone brings automated vengeance to the wasteland, and this is just the beginning. [/p][p]🔹 Scrap Drops – Enemies now explode into valuable loot, complete with a new UI tracker and plans for evolving designs. [/p][p]🔹 Pause Screen Revamp – Stylish, functional, and screenshot-ready. Rotate around your character mid-game and flex your build. [/p][p]🔹 Wave & Day Progression – A sleek new system tracks your current wave, day, and total progress with real-time feedback. [/p][p]🔹 Game Over Report – Fall in battle? We’re laying the groundwork for post-mission stats and summaries. [/p][p]🔹 Under-the-Hood Fixes – Bug fixes, visual tweaks, and polish across the board. [/p][p]🔹 New Stages Incoming – Three brand-new arenas are in development and will be showcased soon![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/G2cDWyyRY7"][b]Discord[/b][/url] and be part of the journey as we build this bullet hell survival experience together! Click the link below and join the fight![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Wasteland Warriors Dev Team[/p][p]2DPK Studios[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #3

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content: [p]In this episode, we’re diving deep into the player controller, enemy AI, and NavMesh system for Wasteland Warriors! From implementing Scriptable Objects for easy character customization to adding a stamina system, combat mechanics, and enemy behavior—there’s a ton of exciting progress to cover![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="CZbjUY-eIfs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]What’s New? [/p][p]🔹 Player Controller Overhaul – Now powered by Scriptable Objects for seamless character swapping! [/p][p]🔹 Stamina System – Manage your stamina wisely or risk being overrun by zombies! [/p][p]🔹 Death Animation & State – Yes, the player can now officially die. [/p][p]🔹 Enemy Spawning System – A fully functional Enemy Spawner Controller and Spawn Zones for dynamic encounters! [/p][p]🔹 First Zombie AI Prototype – Featuring NavMesh pathfinding, a new attack system, and damage calculations! [/p][p]🔹 Basic HP & Stamina UI – A placeholder visual to track your survival.[/p][p][/p][p]This devlog showcases major steps forward in both player movement and enemy AI, bringing Wasteland Warriors one step closer to reality.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/G2cDWyyRY7"][b]Discord[/b][/url] and be part of the journey as we build this bullet hell survival experience together! Click the link below and join the fight![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Wasteland Warriors Dev Team[/p][p]2DPK Studios[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content: [p]Welcome to the Wasteland Warriors game dev log! In this episode, we dive into the character controller mechanics of [b]Wasteland Warriors[/b].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="eSSPO4QLEjA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In this breakdown, I’ll cover how movement, rotation, and stamina-based actions like running, dodging, and vaulting work in Wasteland Warriors. Unlike traditional shooters, the player won’t attack directly—customizable combat drones will do the fighting for you! Learn how these mechanics shape gameplay and how obstacles impact enemy pathing.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Join the [url="https://discord.com/invite/G2cDWyyRY7"][b]Discord[/b][/url] and be part of the journey as we build this bullet hell survival experience together!
